Expected wins and luck

Source: R/rates.R
expected_wins.Rd

Pythagorean expectation: a team's win share follows from points scored and allowed as PTS^k / (PTS^k + OPP^k). The exponent k is fitted per league by least squares on log(W/L) = k log(PTS/OPP) (about 14 in the NBA). luck = actual minus expected wins. Because a team has little control over how well opponents shoot 3s, o_p3_vs_league (opponents' 3P% minus the league's) is added as a second luck marker.

Usage

expected_wins(teams, exponent = NULL)

Arguments

teams

Team season totals with w, l, pts, o_pts and optionally o_p3m, o_p3a.

exponent

Fixed exponent instead of fitting one.

Value

teams with exponent, exp_win_pct, exp_w, luck and, if possible, o_p3_vs_league.

Examples

ew <- expected_wins(team_seasons)
head(ew[order(-ew$luck), c("league", "team", "w", "exp_w", "luck")])
#> # A tibble: 6 × 5
#>   league     team      w exp_w  luck
#>   <chr>      <chr> <int> <dbl> <dbl>
#> 1 NBA        LAL      50  44.0  6.04
#> 2 NBA        IND      50  46.2  3.76
#> 3 EuroLeague ULK      23  19.5  3.49
#> 4 EuroLeague MUN      19  16.3  2.65
#> 5 NBA        CLE      64  61.4  2.64
#> 6 NBA        WSH      18  15.5  2.52
